headings.style_notes: Editorial, elegant, and sharp. Use tight tracking (tracking-tighter) for massive headings. Do NOT use Inter or generic sans for headings.

body.style_notes: Clean, sterile contrast to the expressive serif. Use leading-relaxed for legibility.

accent.style_notes: Use for overlines, step numbers, and micro-copy. Always uppercase with tracking-[0.2em].

colors.notes: Palette inspired by Luxury and Swiss Brutalism. Dark, moody, with a striking 'Rust/Orange' accent for provocation. Do NOT use pure black (#000000).

layouts.hero: Kinetic, typography-led. Massive serif heading that fills the viewport. Masked line-by-line reveal using Framer Motion. A dark abstract background texture with a subtle grain overlay.
layouts.about: Asymmetrical split. Image on one side overlapping a dark surface container holding the bio. Use the dark orange accent chair image as a visual metaphor.
layouts.manifesto: Numbered editorial blocks. Bento-style grid but with wide gaps and overlapping numbers (using the Mono font).
layouts.quiz: Interactive stacked cards or bento boxes. Each question provokes the user gently. High contrast on the active/selected state. Leads seamlessly to contact.
layouts.testimonials: Editorial pull-quotes. Large serif quote marks, subtle borders. Not standard generic cards.
layouts.contact: Minimalist split layout. Left side: Massive typography CTA and WhatsApp link. Right side: Clean form (Lead capture).

grids.strategy: MODE A: The 'Tetris' Grid. High tension, asymmetrical. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12.
grids.spans: Mix spans. For example, the image spans 5 columns, while the text spans 6 columns, leaving 1 column empty for breathing room.

visual_enhancers.grain: MANDATORY. Add a subtle fixed noise/grain overlay (opacity 3-5%) across the entire site to remove the digital flatness. Use CSS or a base64 background.
visual_enhancers.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Very slow, elegant serif text: '• A MUDANÇA INCOMODA • VOCÊ ESTÁ FUGINDO? • TERAPIA É PARA QUEM TEM CORAGEM •'. Low contrast text.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px subtle borders (border-border/40) on structural containers to give a technical/editorial feel.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp brutalist rectangular. Use the primary color (#E35A3D). Hover state must have a distinct transform and color shift.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Input/Textarea. Customize to have transparent backgrounds, border-b only, or very subtle surface backgrounds.
components.accordion: Minimalist styling. Use for the 'Como funciona' details.

motion.scrolling: Use lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. This is critical for the premium feel.
motion.reveals: Framer motion for text: staggerChildren, y: 50 -> 0, opacity 0 -> 1. Spring physics (stiffness 100, damping 20).
motion.micro_interactions: Hover on cards shifts them slightly (-translate-y-2) with a shadow increase. Hover on images scales them slowly (scale-105) inside an overflow-hidden container.

accessibility.contrast: Text must meet APCA standards. All text over images must use a dark gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 to-transparent).
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus-visible ring.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-hidden='true' for the noise texture and decorative marquee.

3d_libraries_and_steps.recommendation: Use framer-motion 3D (useScroll, useTransform) for layered parallax on the hero and image sections. No need for full R3F. Framer Motion + CSS Parallax is more reliable for typography-led sites and provides the required awwwards feel.

hero_background.description: Dark, rippling water/fluid texture to represent the depths of the mind. Put behind the main hero text with low opacity and noise.

about_grazi.description: Sophisticated, moody portrait of a woman. Use as the representation of Grazi. Apply a grayscale or desaturated filter via CSS.

metaphor_chair.description: Modern orange armchair on dark background. Symbol of the 'provocative therapy couch'. Use in the manifesto/quiz section.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, @studio-freight/lenis (or lenis), react-fast-marquee, lucide-react, sonner.
Add 'Playfair Display', 'Manrope', and 'JetBrains Mono' via Google Fonts in index.html.
Implement a global noise overlay (a fixed div with pointer-events-none and a base64 noise background image).
Hero Section: Build a cinematic text reveal using Framer Motion. Text should read 'A terapia não é para todos. Apenas para quem tem coragem de olhar no espelho.'

Quiz Section 'Descubra por que você precisa de terapia': Create an interactive component with 3-4 questions with witty answers (e.g., 'Você foge de conflitos ou cria eles na sua cabeça?'). Use state to show a provocative conclusion that leads to the booking CTA.
About Grazi: Emphasize the 'TCC + Psicologia Provocativa' approach. Make it sound sophisticated but sharp. Use the provided sophisticated woman portrait.
Forms: Use the Shadcn UI Form components to capture Lead (Name, Email, Challenge) and mock saving it. Also add a fixed floating WhatsApp button.
Marquee: Place a slow moving Marquee separating sections.
Never use generic centered 'Bootstrap' style layouts. Use asymmetric grids.
CRITICAL: Generate .js component files, not .tsx. You have .js files.
Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, inputs, and major sections.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. It breaks animations.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Lucide icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts. Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on dropdowns or overlays.
